description:
Update the npx proxy to the newest Pharaoh release, with the user's consent.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• The user asks to update Pharaoh, or accepts a notice that a new Pharaoh version is available

RETURNS: On the npx proxy, whether the newest release passed verification (npm's registry signature and its build provenance) and is staged; it becomes active at the next session start. On a hosted connection, that it is already current.
name: pharaoh_update
title: Update Pharaoh
